name: Gradaly v5.0.0
title: Gradaly v5.0.0
notes:
### 🚀 Gradaly v5.0.0 — Multi-Model Benchmark Suites, Mutually Exclusive `OR` Criteria & Local AI Token Usage Ledger
- **Multi-Model Benchmark & Regression Test Suites**: Capture human-validated exam copies and questions (`⭐`) into reusable benchmark suites to evaluate and compare AI models side-by-side (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, institutional servers, and local Ollama). Includes a structured provider/model selector, mandatory pre-flight Vision & Python sandbox verification before campaign launch, configurable multi-threaded execution (`1–16` parallel workers with VRAM protection for local Ollama), a live multi-phase progress bar, detailed accuracy metrics (MAE, exact match rate, per-criterion F1, latency, token usage), and 1-click opening of any benchmark suite as a full Gradaly project to inspect and refine ground truth.
- **Mutually Exclusive Rubric Criteria (`OR` Groups) & Malus Tiers**: Link consecutive positive criteria (e.g., partial credit *OR* full credit tiers) or negative malus criteria into mutually exclusive `OR` groups — manually or via the AI Rubric Assistant. Checking one criterion in an `OR` group automatically unchecks the others, `Max possible` / `Min possible` bounds are computed accurately per group, and `OR` groups are clearly displayed across the Grading Console, Annotated PDFs, Review Portal, and Encrypted Student Web Portals.
- **Gap-Insertion Drag-and-Drop & Unified Render / Edit KaTeX Toggle**: Reorder questions, PDF pages, individual criteria, or entire `OR` criterion groups together with an explicit visual gap-insertion indicator. Added a unified **Render / Edit** button across criterion descriptions, question grading instructions, project AI prompts, AI justifications, and student feedback to seamlessly switch between live Markdown + KaTeX math rendering and source editing.
- **100% Local AI Token Usage Ledger, Time-Series Charts & Custom Pricing (`~/.gradaly_ai_usage.jsonl`)**: Every AI call (single & batch grading, rubric assistant, prompt coherence checks, diagnostics, and benchmark campaigns) automatically logs input and output/reasoning tokens, date, provider, and model locally on your machine with zero student personal data. Open **AI Usage & Costs** (`Coins` icon in the header or in Settings) to view daily/monthly bar charts and cumulative curves, filter by provider/model/category, export to CSV, reset the ledger, and configure custom `$ / 1M` input/output token rates strictly for providers and models you have previously used.
